reason: A is the better, though still under-specified, proposal because it ties a directly measurable obstacle population to yield strength/hardness, includes tensile testing and dislocation-level characterization, and has some composition-specific support from CoCrFeNiTix. B rests more strongly on the unsupported assumption that equimolar CoCrFeNiTi is nearly ideal and SRO-free, and its falsification rule incorrectly requires reduced plasticity even though obstacle strengthening need not necessarily reduce ductility.
